payload.rebuttal: fixed: I reproduced this mutation too, replacing ledger.record_push(task_id, head_sha) with a bare UPDATE, and confirmed the full adopt test suite, including test_an_adopted_head_and_state_move_are_facts_the_fold_keeps, stayed green. The reason is real: ledger.adopt_pull_request, called right after, re-reads the row's live pushed_sha and bakes it into its own task_package fact, so the folded ledger's final state comes out correct even when record_push itself wrote no fact. Checking only the folded row's materialized state was vacuous for this claim. I changed test_an_adopted_head_and_state_move_are_facts_the_fold_keeps to read the MemoryRecord directly and assert a genuine task_push fact exists carrying the adopted head, independent of what adopt_pull_request's own fact happens to carry. I confirmed this now fails against the exact mutation and passes against the real code, then committed it (dd9fc92b) along with a full re-run of ruff, ty, ast-grep, the prose ratchet, and tests/test_cli.py (191 passed).
